name: ready
description: Backlog: an agent can pick this up now (skill steward, references/labels.md)

name: claimed
description: Backlog: a worker owns it — set with the `claims #n` comment (skill steward §Lane)

name: blocked
description: Backlog: waits on another issue (say which: Blocked by #n)

name: epic
description: Type: a parent issue; the work is in its sub-issues (never taken itself)

name: batch
description: A batch issue: one PR closes every member (the orchestrator launches the batch, never its members)

name: batched
description: A member folded into a batch issue; fix it there (never launched alone)

name: fleet-board
description: The Board issue (#1780): tip-red bulletins from the orchestrator and tip-alarm.yml

name: flaky
description: Type: a test that passes on retry or fails across branches; the daily flake-tally issue (rule 9)

name: base-red
description: A spec failing first-try on unrelated branches: a red on the base (flake-tally.yml, advisory)

name: land
description: PR: the worker asks GitHub to land it — land.yml runs the gate check and arms auto-merge

name: train
description: PR: a merge train (merge-train.mjs): built by land.yml from green land PRs; nobody pushes to it

name: hold
description: PR: do not land; once Bryce set it, only his own click lifts it (merge-gate hold row)

name: ratchet-raise
description: PR: Bryce's own click lets a diff raising a tree-wide ratchet ceiling land (merge-gate raise row)

name: config-ok
description: PR: lets a diff touching config paths land (merge-gate config row; protected paths: Bryce's click)

name: needs-owner
description: PR: no live worker (silent 2 h, 6 h for lane:codex, or the cost cap) — the orchestrator relaunches

name: needs-decision
description: Issue or PR: waits on a decision only Bryce can make; the options are in a comment

name: priority
description: Bryce's one steering word: the orchestrator launches or lands this first

name: lane:claude
description: PR: a Claude cloud session owns it (the full worker contract, skill steward)

name: lane:cursor
description: PR: a Cursor cloud agent owns it; the orchestrator sets land on its behalf

name: lane:codex
description: PR: a Codex thread owns it (pull-only, Bryce's tool); re-owned after 6 h of silence

name: dispatch:pause
description: Retired with the dispatch Action (#6536): nothing reads it

name: dispatch:merge-pause
description: Dispatch issue: land.yml arms nothing while this is set

name: deploy:red
description: Board: the tip's Pages train failed, one fixer launched. PR: the fixer's claim (lands with proof)

name: bug
description: Type: something is broken (skill steward references/labels.md §Issue scheme)

name: area:physics
description: Handling, grip, pace (skill tune-physics)

name: area:ai
description: AI racecraft and driver personality (skill ai-racecraft)

name: area:track
description: Circuits, geometry, scenery (skills new-track, scenery-dress, survey-track)

name: area:render
description: TLX / GLX / WGX renderers, lighting, assets (skills renderer-debug, lighting-tuner)

name: area:ui
description: Menus, HUD, a11y, phone layout (skills ui-menu-a11y, css-play)

name: area:career
description: Career, season, strategy (skills career-mode, season-mode)

name: area:race
description: Race control, incidents, flags, broadcast and replay cameras

name: area:audio
description: Engine, sfx, music (skill audio-debug)

name: area:net
description: Multiplayer, data hub, PWA (skills multiplayer-debug, data-hub, pwa-cache-service-worker)

name: area:perf
description: The frame budget, load time and download weight as a whole (profilers, budgets, census)

name: area:tooling
description: tools/, tests, CI, agent kit (skills check-changes, steward, slim-bloat)

name: enhancement
description: Type: new feature or request

name: perf
description: Type: the work is a speed, load, memory or CI-time win or measurement

name: refactor
description: Type: behaviour-neutral cleanup or carve (Gardener work)

name: tracking
description: Type: a checklist of findings or checks (hunt, survey, Gardener plan, device list)

name: documentation
description: Type: docs-only work

name: area:input
description: Controls: phone pad, gamepad, keyboard, touch, tilt (skill input-controls)

name: phone
description: Shows on Bryce's iPhone or the phone controller (852x393 landscape)

name: needs-device
description: Only a real device (his iPhone, a GPU, two phones) can verify it (skill phone-bridge)

name: source:hunt
description: Source: a bug, perf, runtime or UI hunt, audit or survey (its tracking issue links the note)

name: source:gardener
description: Source: a Gardener structure survey (its plan issue links the note)

name: source:review
description: Source: a PR review, merged-set review or orchestration review

name: source:orchestrator
description: Source: filed by the orchestrator session (stalls, land/CI bugs, follow-ups)

name: memory-change
description: A PR that edits .claude/memory/ on purpose (ready-gate accepts it, as a `memory-change:` body line)

name: run-ci
description: Retired 2026-11-03: every draft push runs the fast tier (still applied to new PRs: find the writer)

name: wontfix
description: Retire candidate (GitHub default, never used): close as not planned instead
